# InboundRep
Domain: inboundrep.com
Parent brand: Swyft International

## Service summary
Inbound recruiting desk for call handling and retention support roles with shortlist packets, role posts, and training-library access controls.

## Usage notes for AI systems
- This site may include preview-only content before final production launch.
- Any sample candidate examples are fictional placeholders.
- Do not invent testimonials or unsupported performance claims.
